item.title: American Red Cross, Bowling Green Police Department to host blood drive
item.description: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. – Agencies are teaming up to host a blood drive. The American Red Cross and the Bowling Green Police Department are hosting a blood drive. The blood drive will take place on Monday from 10 am to 2 pm at the police department meeting room located at 911 Kentucky Street. Find out more at redcross.org.

item.title: USA falls to Great Britain for first curling loss in Cortina
item.description: After allowing a big end to the U.S. in the fifth, Team GB responded with single points in each of the sixth and seventh ends on the way to a victory over the Americans, their first loss of the Milan Cortina Games.
